mainEntity.name: Is AEO more expensive than traditional SEO for cosmetic surgeons?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AEO versus traditional SEO isn't necessarily higher, but it involves a different allocation of resources. AEO often requires a significant investment in high-quality, expertly written content that directly answers specific questions, along with structured data implementation. Traditional SEO might focus more on technical site audits and link building. Many agencies integrate AEO into a comprehensive SEO strategy, so costs are often bundled. The overall expense depends on the scope of work, the number of procedures you want to target, and the competitive landscape. Focusing on AEO can provide a higher ROI for practices targeting direct answers.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO cost isn't inherently higher than SEO, but it reallocates resources towards high-quality, question-answering content and structured data. Often integrated, its ROI can be strong for direct answers.
